incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=inference-queue-prod (alert=queue_depth_high). queue_depth=2312 for 3m. page_id=PD12345

pagerduty: page fired -> awaiting ack

maya (oncall): ACK — I'm taking this. Seeing sustained queue depth and latency spike. Any quick wins? :eyes:

raj (eng-oncall): investigating autoscaler. Metrics show desired_replicas trending up but actual pod count stuck at 12. Looks like nodepool provisioning is failing. Pulling logs now.

alex (sre): I'm in console — GPU nodepool quota at limit for the region. Opening emergency quota request with cloud provider now.

maya (oncall): Can we do a soft fallback to a smaller model for non-critical routes to reduce load?

raj (eng-oncall): Yes — pushing a temporary routing change to divert ~30% of traffic to the smaller model. Command: 
```
POST /v1/routing
{
  "service": "inference",
  "rule": "route_low_priority",
  "target_model": "gpt-small",
  "weight": 0.3
}
```

pagerduty: page escalated to second on-call (alex) at 2025-06-20T10:08:00Z

alex (sre): Quota request submitted (ticket: Q-9273). ETA from provider ~10–15m. Meanwhile I'll manually scale CPU-backed shared pool and nudge the load balancer to rebalance traffic.

support-team: CS reports multiple customers seeing increased latency (~2–4s). Posting a short status update now.

maya (oncall): Status: "Degraded performance for text-generation; mitigation in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD12345 

raj (eng-oncall): autoscaler logs snippet: 
```
2025-06-20T10:06:47Z WARN desired_replicas=40 actual_replicas=12 scale_error="nodepool_quota_exceeded"
2025-06-20T10:07:12Z INFO scale_retry backoff=30s
```

maya (oncall): Good context. Plan: keep PD acknowledged, route low-priority traffic away, manual bump if provider ETA slips. If p95 latency stays >2s for 15m, escalate to infra director.

alex (sre): Applied manual patch to autoscaler controller to increase replicas to 20 as stopgap: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch deploy autoscaler --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"replicas":20}}'
```
Monitoring pod startup and queue drain.

pagerduty: page acknowledged by maya (oncall) at 2025-06-20T10:15:22Z

maya (oncall): Manual follow-ups: raj to own postmortem, add runbook step for nodepool quota in the autoscaler playbook, alex to follow up on quota ticket until nodes are available. I'll keep status page updated.

raj (eng-oncall): Noted — assigning myself as incident owner. Early root cause hypothesis: autoscaler assumes nodepool can always provision; missing guard for quota exhaustion and no automated infra escalation. Will add to postmortem.

alex (sre): Provider replied — temporary quota bump granted (Q-9273) in ~9m. Pods are joining cluster; observed pod count rising to 28 now.

support-team: CS notified customers of mitigation, will send follow-up once performance OK.

maya (oncall): Closing alert timeline here. Leave PD incident open until metrics steady for 30m. Postmortem owner: raj. Action items: add infra escalation step to runbook, add a PD rule to escalate on nodepool quota errors.
